provenance.post_title: Inside Pathfinder Tokens: Character Gallery for Foundry VTT
provenance.asset_description: A screenshot taken within Foundry VTT, showing the Character Gallery application being used to search for characters in the “explorers” family and wielding bows. The user has elected to replace the artwork of their current character, and a dialog window is open, previewing the change and awaiting confirmation.
